svg.title: Parallax system architecture
svg.text: Next.js Mission Control ⇄ FastAPI orchestrator → Hotdata forks · RocketRide pipelines · Cognee memory · Snyk in CI. Every cloud piece has a zero-key local fallback.

g.text: zustand store applies SSE events in order
asyncio.gather + semaphore(agents) · one fork per hypothesis
in-flight counter → peak concurrency · p50 / p95 per query
api.hotdata.dev/v1 · HTTP · read-only HotSQL · forks in ms
one forked database per hypothesis · findings table + NOTES context on each
POST …/indexes → bm25 on data, vector on data_vec
cognify() in a background task · never blocks a run

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: db_hotdata → llm (control) · GRAPH_COMPLETION on dataset parallax
use() once · chat() per planner / agent / synth call
Local mode · runs on a laptop with no accounts
CI on every push and pull request
continue-on-error · badge links to the public report

svg.text: selected by data / llm / memory factories when no keys are set
